understanding.goal_understanding: Complete each level by getting all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked with '+', such that every goal tile is occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN; then proceed through all levels until the full run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were issued as CLICKs on grid coordinates. A selectable piece could be moved/commanded by clicking target tiles; if the path or destination was blocked by walls/obstacles or the click had no valid movement effect, the piece would not move. When a move was valid, the currently selected piece relocated to the clicked coordinate (or along an implied path to it). Selection persisted across turns unless explicitly changed by clicking/selecting another piece (not observed here). Pushing behavior was not clearly evidenced in the last turns shown; attempted moves into blocked spaces resulted in no movement, suggesting obstacles/walls prevent entry and do not get displaced.
